fields.description: Block-0 status/tag byte of the EEPROM header block (logical offset 0). Fresh save holds 0x00, consistent with a valid/new-save marker persisted with the header words.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806b2d4 deserializes EEPROM block 0 (8 bytes = 4x u16) via DMA through 0x0D000000/FUN_0806b254 into stack buffer auStack_98 and stores word 0 low byte to save offset 0; FUN_0806b384/FUN_0806b4b8 persist the same block. Value 0x00 verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: header_status

fields.description: Block-0 header code word (logical offsets 1-2, LE value 0x03A9 = 937). Persisted with the magic words; brute-forced sum8/sum16/xor8 over header ranges show it is not a checksum of the magic/progress bytes, so it is carried as a plain version/code word.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806b2d4 reads EEPROM block 0 words into (ushort*)(param_2+6..0), covering save offsets 0-7; FUN_0806b384 writes the same layout and FUN_0806b460/FUN_0806b4b8 verify it by read-back compare. Bytes A9 03 verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: header_code

fields.description: 12-character ASCII game identifier 'HAMUPARAPURE' ('Hamster Paradise Pure') starting at logical offset 3 with NUL terminator at offset 15. Only valid when read in the rev8-logical domain (raw bytes are bit-reversed per 8-byte block).
fields.evidence: Persisted by the EEPROM block routines FUN_0806b2d4 (read) / FUN_0806b384 (write via FUN_0806b254 DMA to 0x0D000000) / FUN_0806b4b8 (write+verify); logical bytes 48 41 4D 55 50 41 52 41 50 55 52 45 verified in samples/baseline.sav with eeprom_rev8=true.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: NUL terminator of the save_magic string at logical offset 15 (end of EEPROM block 1). Fresh save holds 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806b2d4 deserializes EEPROM block 1 into save offsets 8-15 and FUN_0806b460 compares all 4 words back on verify; byte 0x00 at offset 15 verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: magic_terminator

fields.description: Gameplay progress flags word 0 (EEPROM block 2, first word). Fresh save is 0x0000; written/read as part of the 8-byte progress blocks, expected to hold unlock/event flag bits during play.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806b2d4 reads 8-byte EEPROM blocks (4x u16) into consecutive save offsets and FUN_0806b384/FUN_0806b4b8 write them back with read-back verification in FUN_0806b460. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical offsets 0x10-0x11).
fields.name: progress_flags_a

fields.description: Gameplay progress flags word 1 (EEPROM block 2, second word). Fresh save is 0x0000; companion flag bits to progress_flags_a.
fields.evidence: Same 4-word block transfer as progress_flags_a: FUN_0806b2d4 (read via FUN_0806b254 DMA from 0x0D000000) / FUN_0806b384 (write) / FUN_0806b460 (compare). Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical offsets 0x12-0x13).
fields.name: progress_flags_b

fields.description: Gameplay counter word 0 (EEPROM block 2, third word; e.g. currency/score-adjacent counter). Fresh save is 0x0000.
fields.evidence: Carried in the FUN_0806b2d4 4-word block read into save offsets 0x10-0x17 and persisted by FUN_0806b384/FUN_0806b4b8. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical offsets 0x14-0x15).
fields.name: progress_count_a

fields.description: Gameplay counter word 1 (EEPROM block 2, fourth word). Fresh save is 0x0000.
fields.evidence: Carried in the FUN_0806b2d4 4-word block read into save offsets 0x10-0x17 and persisted by FUN_0806b384/FUN_0806b4b8. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical offsets 0x16-0x17).
fields.name: progress_count_b

fields.description: Gameplay progress value A (EEPROM block 3 as u32 LE; e.g. score/playtime-adjacent accumulator). Fresh save is 0.
fields.evidence: EEPROM block 3 (save offsets 0x18-0x1F) moves through the same FUN_0806b2d4 read / FUN_0806b384 write / FUN_0806b460 verify path as 4x u16 words. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: progress_value_a

fields.description: Gameplay progress value B (EEPROM block 4 as u32 LE). Fresh save is 0.
fields.evidence: EEPROM block 4 (save offsets 0x20-0x27) moves through FUN_0806b2d4 (read) / FUN_0806b384 (write via FUN_0806b254 to 0x0D000000) / FUN_0806b4b8 (write+verify). Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: progress_value_b

fields.description: Extended gameplay data word A (EEPROM block 5, low half). Fresh save is 0.
fields.evidence: EEPROM block 5 (save offsets 0x28-0x2F) is the last header-adjacent block transferred by FUN_0806b2d4/FUN_0806b384 as 4x u16. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: gameplay_ext_a

fields.description: Extended gameplay data word B (EEPROM block 5, high half). Fresh save is 0.
fields.evidence: EEPROM block 5 high half (save offsets 0x2C-0x2F) transferred by FUN_0806b2d4/FUN_0806b384 as the 4th u16 pair with verification in FUN_0806b460. Zero value verified in samples/baseline.sav (rev8-logical).
fields.name: gameplay_ext_b

fields.description: Trailing 8-byte record at logical offset 0x0F40 (EEPROM block 488), all zeros in the fresh save. Present in the live capture but its role is unresolved in the recovered decomp; carried as raw bytes.
fields.evidence: 8 zero bytes at rev8-logical 0x0F40-0x0F47 verified in samples/baseline.sav; the only recovered EEPROM accessors are the 8-byte block routines FUN_0806b2d4 (read), FUN_0806b384 (write) and FUN_0806b4b8 (write+verify), so this block is only reachable through that same 4-word path.
fields.name: far_record
